rescueTop10.event: Legendary Founding of Rome by Romulus
rescueTop10.significance: Palatine fortifications, Asylum, Sabine women, 100 Senators, and patron-client system vs Iron Age hut post-holes.
Numa establishes Vestals, Pontiffs, and Temple of Janus; Tullus wins Horatii duel and destroys Alba Longa.
Drains Forum via Cloaca Maxima, lays out Circus Maximus, and expands Senate.
Reorganises citizens by wealth into Comitia Centuriata, urban tribes, Servian Walls, and Diana temple.
Murders Servius, builds Jupiter Capitolinus temple, and falls in 509 BC after Sextus assaults Lucretia.

rescueTop10.event: Birth of Republic, Lars Porsenna & Lake Regillus
rescueTop10.significance: Brutus & Collatinus become first consuls; survive Porsenna of Clusium and Latin League at Lake Regillus.

rescueTop10.event: First Plebeian Secession to Mons Sacer
rescueTop10.significance: Debt bondage (nexum) drives plebeian walkout; Menenius Agrippa negotiates sacrosanct Tribunes of the Plebs.
Transfers election of plebeian tribunes to the Tribal Assembly (Concilium Plebis), curbing patrician interference.
Written Twelve Tables codified, but Appius Claudius’ tyranny (Verginia) sparks the Second Secession.
Restores appeal, makes plebiscita binding, and Lex Canuleia (445 BC) legalises patrician-plebeian intermarriage.
